name: H01_gorehorn_raider_raid_can_hit_a_planeswalker
note: Gorehorn Raider: 'any target' includes a planeswalker. P0 attacks with a 0/2 Scout, then casts the Raider and aims the trigger at the opponent's Vivien Reid (loyalty 5): damage dealt to a planeswalker removes that many loyalty counters (CR 120.3c), so exactly 2 come off (5 -> 3); the opponent's life is untouched.
